definitions.short: properly, pointed , i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed
definitions.full: H2738. charul חָרוּל noun [masculine] a kind of weed, perhaps chickpea ( cicercula ), see Löw p. 153 (Syriac fodder for horses ; ᵑ7 Prov 24:31 gives חוּרְלָא ) — absolute ׳ח Job 30:6 ; Zeph 2:9 ; plural חֲרֻלִים Prov 24:31 ; — as growing in devastated land, collective Zeph 2:9 ; in vineyard of slothful, plural ח פניו ׳כִּסּוּ Prov 24:31 (|| קִמְּשׂגִים ); as sole shelter of certain outcast peoples Job 30:7 ( שִׂיחִים ).
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) חָרֻל ; apparently, a passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly;
